overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong professional academic presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, totaling 3,580 followers. His content consistently focuses on computational social science, disinformation research, tool releases, and recruitment, generating high engagement rates particularly on Bluesky and LinkedIn.

contentThemes.description: Sharing newly published papers, grants, and tool releases like CooRnet v2.0.
Recruiting postdoctoral researchers and PhD candidates for computational social science projects.
Discussing cross-platform disinformation methods and upcoming conference presentations.

recommendations: Cross-promote major research milestones simultaneously across all three networks with platform-tailored calls to action.
Increase engagement on Mastodon by opening threads for peer discussion on open-source tools like CooRnet.
Leverage LinkedIn's large follower base to boost recruitment drive visibility.

platformInsights.bluesky: Highest average engagement rate (6.14%), driven by strong repost activity on publication and student opportunity posts.
platformInsights.mastodon: Niche academic audience that engages well with open-source software tools (CooRnet) and computational methodology topics.
platformInsights.linkedin: Largest follower base (1,850 followers) driving the highest absolute number of interactions (likes and comments), especially for grant awards and hiring posts.
